summary: Fate Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that on September 25, 2026 the California Institute for Regenerative Medicine awarded the company a $15.0 million CLIN2 grant to support the Phase 2 potentially registrational RECLAIM-LN trial of FT819, an off-the-shelf iPSC-derived CAR T-cell therapy in refractory moderate-to-severe SLE with lupus nephritis. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1; no board recommendation, advisor, securities terms, or transaction mechanics are stated. This is a routine grant and pipeline announcement, not a special situation.
